title: fix off-by-one in lastN()
description: src/array-utils.js exports `lastN(arr, n)` which is supposed to return the last n elements. The current implementation has an off-by-one and returns n-1 elements (or fails on edge cases). The fix is small but the test covers multiple edge cases (n === 0, n > arr.length, empty array).

issue.title: lastN() returns one fewer element than requested
issue.body:
src/array-utils.js's `lastN(arr, n)` has an off-by-one bug. Cases to satisfy:

- lastN([1,2,3,4,5], 3) → [3,4,5]
- lastN([1,2,3], 0) → []
- lastN([1,2,3], 10) → [1,2,3]
- lastN([], 3) → []

See test.js for the exact acceptance criteria.
